acceptanceCriteria: non-literal whole exports abstain with runner-config-key-dynamic or a named reason, with a test
Mocha hidden-path matching follows segment-exact semantics, with a test
body: Residual from #1187 (V1-1888, TSA-V0-141/142). A runner config whose whole export is not an object literal (e.g. `module.exports = require('./base')`) is read as runner defaults instead of abstaining, and Mocha's hidden-file exclusion is approximated per pattern: any pattern with a literal `.` segment may match any hidden path.
